steps.action: Map all hosts the user authenticated to within the detection window. These are your blast-radius candidates.
Disable the user account and revoke all active sessions across every host.
On each affected host: check for new processes, scheduled tasks, services, or files created by the account.
Review outbound connections from each host — look for beaconing, data staging, or C2 activity.
Restore affected hosts from clean snapshots if tampering is confirmed. Force credential rotation.
Segment the network to restrict east-west authentication. Enforce MFA for all lateral-movement-prone protocols (RDP, SMB, WinRM).
List all compromised hosts and the authentication chain. Attach timeline.
